projects.title: GULLY//OS — Kaka's Tapri
projects.problem: Portfolios are static and boring. Recruiters skim, developers bounce.
projects.built: A gully-themed portfolio with Kaka, an AI chai-wala powered by AWS Bedrock who answers visitor questions in Hinglish and drives the UI — opening projects, scrolling sections — all through agentic tool use.
projects.role: Solo — designed the concept, built the React frontend, Lambda backend, and SAM infrastructure.

projects.title: Sensei — Emotion & Engagement Analyzer
projects.problem: Online educators can't see if students are engaged or lost behind their screens.
projects.built: A real-time multi-face emotion and engagement analysis tool using ONNX Runtime (HSEmotion/EfficientNet-B0) with DeepFace fallback, streaming analytics at 30fps over Flask + WebSockets.
projects.role: Solo — built during AI fellowship, aligned with UN SDG 4 (Quality Education).

projects.title: Lawris — Legal Intelligence Platform
projects.problem: Indian lawyers waste hours searching through statutes and drafting standard legal documents manually.
projects.built: A two-tier RAG platform over 761 statute chunks (BNS, BNSS, CPC, POCSO, Supreme Court judgments) with Gemini 2.5 Flash for streaming document drafting, zero-hallucination citation grounding linked to indiacode.nic.in, and a BNSS §187(3) deadline engine.
projects.role: Lead developer — architecture, RAG pipeline, and deployment.

projects.title: Safar AI — AI Travel Planner
projects.problem: Planning multi-day trips across Indian destinations is time-consuming and generic.
projects.built: An AI travel planner that generates structured day-wise itineraries with budget breakdowns using Gemini API, with conversational replanning agents that adjust specific trip parts without rebuilding the whole schedule.
projects.role: Co-author — published in IJRASET, Volume 14, October 2026.
